notes: Handwritten bibliographic/work list arranged under Raynaud, Illusie 1 and Deligne with a small adjacent ambiguous mark. Every list entry was read, including witness agreements. Authorship of the hand is not inferred from this sheet.

The Raynaud block lists a Mumford Theta title, Papiers Kiehl and Artin-Winters. The middle group includes letters, Affine duality, extensions, a cancelled Notes entry, the R. Wood Bourbaki line, a cot complex, an Atiyah/Omega1 title, Koszul and cancelled Borel/Lecture Notes.

The Deligne group contains Monsky-Washnitzer and several cancelled titles/papers. The Griffiths On monodromy entry remains live. The hatched parenthetic suite/suiten note stays below the left heading.

Numerical information is preserved without assigning administrative meaning: Illusie 1; the ambiguous 1/2/? by Deligne; I and II after two titles; Koszul 2 articles; Manin (2 articles); double-underlined (13) after Papiers d'Artin. No date is visible. Archive numeral 3 appears only in the required comment.

No securely readable verbal hesitation occurs. The mark beside Deligne could be a question mark, but is not promoted to a definite question. The continuation shapes after Omega1 and four points in "On monodromy ...." remain literal.

H list-joining dashes and semicolons are editorial organization, not counted as physical punctuation errors. Equivalent emphasis/handwriting syntax is excluded.
